meta.title: Two-way conversations
meta.why: A conversation is two skills alternating. When the other person speaks you must understand Chinese and recover the meaning (ZH -> EN). When it is your turn you must produce Chinese from an intention (EN -> ZH). Practising only one direction produces learners who can recite but not reply, or understand but freeze. Every dialogue here alternates both.

dialogues.title: Meeting someone new
dialogues.setting: A friend introduces you to someone at dinner.

turns.pinyin: nǐ hǎo, wǒ jiào Chén Wěi
turns.en: Hello, I'm Chen Wei

turns.pinyin: nǐ hǎo, wǒ jiào Lǐ Míng
turns.en: Hello, my name is Li Ming

turns.pinyin: nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?
turns.en: What country are you from?

turns.pinyin: wǒ shì Měiguó rén
turns.en: I'm American

turns.pinyin: nǐ de Zhōngwén hěn hǎo!
turns.en: Your Chinese is very good!

turns.hanzi: 哪里哪里，我会说一点儿
turns.pinyin: nǎli nǎli, wǒ huì shuō yìdiǎnr
turns.en: Not at all — I can only speak a little
turns.note: 哪里哪里 is the standard modest deflection of a compliment. Accepting praise flatly sounds odd in Chinese.

turns.pinyin: xué le duō jiǔ le?
turns.en: How long have you been studying?

turns.pinyin: xué le sān ge yuè
turns.en: Three months

dialogues.title: Ordering a coffee
dialogues.setting: A café counter. There is a queue behind you.

turns.pinyin: nín hǎo, yào hē shénme?
turns.en: Hello, what would you like to drink?

turns.pinyin: wǒ yào yì bēi kāfēi
turns.en: I'd like a cup of coffee

turns.pinyin: dà bēi háishi xiǎo bēi?
turns.en: Large or small?

turns.pinyin: dà bēi, xièxie
turns.en: Large, thanks

turns.pinyin: yígòng sānshíwǔ kuài
turns.en: That's thirty-five yuan altogether

turns.pinyin: kěyǐ yòng Wēixìn zhīfù ma?
turns.en: Can I pay with WeChat?

turns.pinyin: kěyǐ, sǎo zhèlǐ
turns.en: Yes, scan here

turns.pinyin: hǎo de, xièxie
turns.en: OK, thank you

dialogues.title: Taking a taxi
dialogues.setting: You get into a taxi with an address on your phone.

turns.pinyin: qù nǎr?
turns.en: Where to?

turns.pinyin: qǐng dài wǒ qù zhège dìzhǐ
turns.en: Please take me to this address

turns.pinyin: hǎo, dàgài yào bàn ge xiǎoshí
turns.en: OK, it'll take about half an hour

turns.hanzi: 有点儿急，能快一点儿吗？
turns.pinyin: yǒudiǎnr jí, néng kuài yìdiǎnr ma?
turns.en: I'm in a bit of a hurry — could you go a little faster?

turns.pinyin: xiànzài dǔchē, jǐnliàng ba
turns.en: There's traffic now, I'll do what I can

turns.pinyin: méi guānxi, xièxie
turns.en: It's fine, thank you

turns.hanzi: 到了，前面路口停可以吗？
turns.pinyin: dào le, qiánmiàn lùkǒu tíng kěyǐ ma?
turns.en: We're here — can I stop at the intersection ahead?

turns.pinyin: kěyǐ, qǐng gěi wǒ fāpiào
turns.en: Yes — please give me a receipt

dialogues.title: Dinner for two
dialogues.setting: A busy restaurant. You have a dietary restriction.

turns.pinyin: jǐ wèi?
turns.en: How many people?

turns.pinyin: liǎng wèi, yǒu wèizi ma?
turns.en: Two — do you have a table?

turns.pinyin: yǒu, zhèbiān qǐng
turns.en: Yes, this way please

turns.pinyin: qǐng gěi wǒ kàn yíxià càidān
turns.en: Could I see the menu, please

turns.hanzi: 我们的招牌菜是水煮鱼，很辣
turns.pinyin: wǒmen de zhāopái cài shì shuǐzhǔyú, hěn là
turns.en: Our signature dish is boiled fish — it's very spicy

turns.pinyin: wǒ bù chī là, qǐng búyào fàng là
turns.en: I don't eat spicy food — please don't make it spicy

turns.pinyin: méi wèntí, hái yào biéde ma?
turns.en: No problem. Anything else?

turns.pinyin: zài lái yì píng píjiǔ, xièxie
turns.en: One more bottle of beer, thanks

turns.pinyin: hǎo de, qǐng shāo děng
turns.en: Certainly, one moment please

dialogues.title: Haggling at a market
dialogues.setting: A street market. The first price is never the real price.

turns.pinyin: kànkan ba, xǐhuan shénme?
turns.en: Have a look — what do you like?

turns.pinyin: zhège duōshao qián?
turns.en: How much is this?

turns.pinyin: sānbǎi kuài
turns.en: Three hundred yuan

turns.pinyin: tài guì le, néng piányi diǎnr ma?
turns.en: That's too expensive — can you go cheaper?

turns.pinyin: liǎngbǎi bā, bù néng zài shǎo le
turns.en: Two hundred eighty, I can't go lower

turns.pinyin: yìbǎi wǔ zěnmeyàng?
turns.en: How about one hundred fifty?

turns.pinyin: tài dī le, liǎngbǎi ba
turns.en: Too low — let's say two hundred

turns.pinyin: hǎo ba, wǒ yào le
turns.en: Alright, I'll take it

dialogues.title: Catching up with a friend
dialogues.setting: You run into someone you haven't seen in months.

turns.pinyin: hǎo jiǔ bú jiàn! zuìjìn zěnmeyàng?
turns.en: Long time no see! How have you been lately?

turns.pinyin: hái xíng, zuìjìn gōngzuò hěn lèi
turns.en: Not bad — work has been exhausting lately

turns.pinyin: nǐ hái zài nà jiā gōngsī ma?
turns.en: Are you still at that company?

turns.hanzi: 还在，但是我想换个工作
turns.pinyin: hái zài, dànshì wǒ xiǎng huàn ge gōngzuò
turns.en: Still there, but I'm thinking of changing jobs

turns.pinyin: wèishénme? yālì tài dà ma?
turns.en: Why? Is the pressure too much?

turns.hanzi: 因为我经常加班，所以很累
turns.pinyin: yīnwèi wǒ jīngcháng jiābān, suǒyǐ hěn lèi
turns.en: Because I often work overtime, so I'm tired

turns.pinyin: nà nǐ yīnggāi zǎo diǎnr xiūxi
turns.en: Then you should rest earlier

turns.pinyin: nǐ shuō de duì, wǒ huì zhùyì de
turns.en: You're right, I'll be careful

dialogues.title: Making plans
dialogues.setting: Arranging to meet, and then having to move it.

turns.pinyin: zhège zhōumò yǒu kòng ma?
turns.en: Are you free this weekend?

turns.hanzi: 星期六有空，你想做什么？
turns.pinyin: xīngqīliù yǒu kòng, nǐ xiǎng zuò shénme?
turns.en: I'm free Saturday — what do you want to do?

turns.pinyin: wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng ba
turns.en: Let's go see a film

turns.pinyin: hǎo a, wǒmen jǐ diǎn jiàn?
turns.en: Sure — what time shall we meet?

turns.hanzi: 七点半在地铁站怎么样？
turns.pinyin: qī diǎn bàn zài dìtiě zhàn zěnmeyàng?
turns.en: How about seven thirty at the metro station?

turns.pinyin: wǒ kěnéng huì wǎn yìdiǎnr dào
turns.en: I might arrive a bit late

turns.pinyin: méi guānxi, wǒ děng nǐ
turns.en: No problem, I'll wait for you

turns.pinyin: wǒ yí dào jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà
turns.en: I'll call you as soon as I arrive

dialogues.title: A problem at the hotel
dialogues.setting: Your room has issues and you need them fixed tonight.

turns.pinyin: nín hǎo, yǒu shénme kěyǐ bāng nín?
turns.en: Hello, how can I help you?

turns.pinyin: wǒ fángjiān de kōngtiáo huài le
turns.en: The air conditioning in my room is broken

turns.hanzi: 不好意思，我马上安排人去看
turns.pinyin: bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ mǎshàng ānpái rén qù kàn
turns.en: I'm sorry — I'll send someone to look right away

turns.hanzi: 能不能帮我换一个房间？
turns.pinyin: néng bu néng bāng wǒ huàn yí ge fángjiān?
turns.en: Could you move me to another room?

turns.hanzi: 今天满房了，恐怕有点儿困难
turns.pinyin: jīntiān mǎn fáng le, kǒngpà yǒudiǎnr kùnnan
turns.en: We're fully booked today — I'm afraid that's rather difficult

turns.hanzi: 这跟说好的不一样，我有点儿失望
turns.pinyin: zhè gēn shuō hǎo de bù yíyàng, wǒ yǒudiǎnr shīwàng
turns.en: This isn't what was agreed — I'm a little disappointed

turns.hanzi: 实在抱歉，我们给您免一晚房费
turns.pinyin: shízài bàoqiàn, wǒmen gěi nín miǎn yì wǎn fángfèi
turns.en: I'm truly sorry — we'll waive one night's charge

turns.hanzi: 那这样吧，希望今晚能修好
turns.pinyin: nà zhèyàng ba, xīwàng jīnwǎn néng xiū hǎo
turns.en: Let's do that then — I hope it can be fixed tonight

dialogues.title: Disagreeing politely
dialogues.setting: A colleague proposes something you think is a mistake.

turns.hanzi: 我觉得我们应该下周就开始
turns.pinyin: wǒ juéde wǒmen yīnggāi xià zhōu jiù kāishǐ
turns.en: I think we should start as early as next week

turns.hanzi: 我理解你的意思，不过时间太紧了
turns.pinyin: wǒ lǐjiě nǐ de yìsi, búguò shíjiān tài jǐn le
turns.en: I take your point, but the timing is too tight

turns.hanzi: 可是客户一直在催我们
turns.pinyin: kěshì kèhù yìzhí zài cuī wǒmen
turns.en: But the client keeps pushing us

turns.hanzi: 确实有道理，但问题在于质量
turns.pinyin: quèshí yǒu dàolǐ, dàn wèntí zàiyú zhìliàng
turns.en: That's fair, but the problem is quality

turns.pinyin: nà nǐ yǒu shénme jiànyì?
turns.en: So what do you suggest?

turns.hanzi: 我建议我们先做一部分
turns.pinyin: wǒ jiànyì wǒmen xiān zuò yí bùfen
turns.en: I suggest we do one part first

turns.hanzi: 这个想法不错，我们再讨论一下
turns.pinyin: zhège xiǎngfǎ búcuò, wǒmen zài tǎolùn yíxià
turns.en: That's a good idea — let's discuss it further

turns.pinyin: hǎo, nà wǒmen gè ràng yí bù ba
turns.en: Good — let's each give a little then

dialogues.title: Speaking up in a meeting
dialogues.setting: A formal meeting where you need to raise a concern without causing loss of face.

turns.hanzi: 关于这个方案，大家有什么看法？
turns.pinyin: guānyú zhège fāng'àn, dàjiā yǒu shénme kànfǎ?
turns.en: Regarding this proposal, does anyone have views?

turns.hanzi: 关于这个问题，我想补充一点
turns.pinyin: guānyú zhège wèntí, wǒ xiǎng bǔchōng yì diǎn
turns.en: On this question, I'd like to add something

turns.pinyin: qǐng shuō
turns.en: Please go ahead

turns.hanzi: 我个人觉得风险有点儿大
turns.pinyin: wǒ gèrén juéde fēngxiǎn yǒudiǎnr dà
turns.en: Personally I feel the risk is somewhat high

turns.pinyin: jùtǐ shì zhǐ nǎ fāngmiàn?
turns.en: Which aspect specifically?

turns.hanzi: 从长远来看，成本可能会上升
turns.pinyin: cóng chángyuǎn lái kàn, chéngběn kěnéng huì shàngshēng
turns.en: In the long run, costs may rise

turns.hanzi: 你说得有道理，我们需要再评估
turns.pinyin: nǐ shuō de yǒu dàolǐ, wǒmen xūyào zài pínggū
turns.en: You make a fair point — we need to reassess

turns.hanzi: 感谢您的支持，我会准备详细资料
turns.pinyin: gǎnxiè nín de zhīchí, wǒ huì zhǔnbèi xiángxì zīliào
turns.en: Thank you for your support — I'll prepare detailed materials
